title: RNA interference protocol to silence oncogenic drivers in leukemia cell lines
protocol: Resuspend cells in the culture flask for equal distribution.
Transfer the resuspended cells into a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Pipette 50 μL of cell suspension into a 1.5 mL centrifugation tube.
Count the cells with a Neubauer counting chamber.
Calculate the number of cells per mL.
Add 50 μL PBS to the cell suspension.
Resuspend the cells thoroughly in the added PBS.
Seed 0.75 × 10^6 cells per mL in a final volume of 4 mL in a 6 well plate for each sample.
Calculate the total number of cells needed: 9 × 10^6 cells are necessary.
Centrifuge the 9 × 10^6 cells in a 50 mL Falcon tube for 5 min at 200 × g and room temperature (between 15°C and 25°C).
Prepare a 6 well plate with 3 mL fresh complete growth medium for each sample to be electroporated.
Place the prepared 6 well plate in an incubator to prewarm the media.
Aspirate the supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend the cells thoroughly in 3 mL fresh complete growth medium (1 mL per sample) by pipetting.
Add 1 mL cell suspension to each well of the prewarmed media in the 6 well plate, resulting in two wells with 3 × 10^6 cells each.
Incubate the cells overnight for approximately 16 hours at 37°C and 5% CO2 in a humidified atmosphere.
Prepare a NeonTM Electroporation tube with 3 mL Electrolytic Buffer E2.
Place the prepared electroporation tube in the transfection unit, ensuring it clicks into place correctly and there is no large gap under the tube.
Transfer cells from the 6 well plate into 15 mL conical centrifugation tubes.
Resuspend cells thoroughly in each well and transfer with a 1 mL pipette into the centrifuge tube.
Wash each well with 1 mL PBS and transfer to the tube.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 200 × g at room temperature (15°C up to 25°C).
Aspirate supernatant with a vacuum pump.
Resuspend cells in 2 mL PBS.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 200 × g at room temperature (15°C up to 25°C).
Prepare a 6 well plate with 2 mL complete media per sample and place it in the incubator to warm the media.
Aspirate supernatant thoroughly.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL resuspension buffer R from the Thermo Fisher transfection kit.
Transfer cells in electroporation buffer into a 1.5 mL conical centrifugation tube.
Add 100 pmol siRNA to the cells using a stock concentration of 10 μM (10 μL).
Transfer the cells into the 6 well plate with prewarmed medium.
Let the cells adapt overnight (approximately 16 hours).
Count the cells using a Neubauer counting chamber.
Seed 0.2 × 10^6 cells per mL in a final volume of 5 mL in complete medium.
Pipette the volume of 1 × 10^6 cells into a 6 well plate.
Adjust the final volume to 5 mL with complete medium in every well.
Avoid stressing the cells after electroporation.
Do not perform any centrifugation steps on sensitive cells post-electroporation.
Test cell viability using flow cytometry with annexin V/propidium iodide staining for apoptosis detection.
Evaluate apoptosis or cell cycle distribution in small samples of 1 mL cell suspension.
Incubate cells for at least 1 hour before stimulation or overnight at 37°C, 5% CO2 in a humidified atmosphere before harvesting.
Harvest and lyse the cells on the fourth day post-electroporation.
Transfer the cells from the 6 well plate into conical 15 mL centrifugation tubes.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 800 × g at room temperature (15°C up to 25°C).
Aspirate the supernatants with a vacuum pump and a Pasteur pipette or with a 1 mL pipette.
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL PBS and transfer the cells into 1.5 mL centrifugation tubes.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 800 × g at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatants thoroughly.
Add an appropriate amount of complete NET-N lysis buffer to the cells (e.g., around 100 μL per 1 × 10^6 cells).
Lyse the cells for 30 min on ice.
Sonicate the samples for 10 s and an amplitude of 40%.
Centrifuge the tubes for 25 min at 17,000 × g at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatants into new 1.5 mL centrifugation tubes.
Determine protein concentrations in the supernatants (e.g., Bradford or BCA assays).
Equalize the amount of protein in every sample.
Add 6× sample buffer to a final concentration of 1× buffer.
Denature the proteins by boiling for 5 min at 95°C.
Run immunoblot and analyze the proteins of interest.
